question: Who among the following is the Comptroller and Auditor General of India as on 5th September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Girish Chandra Murmu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **As of September 5, 2022, Girish Chandra Murmu is the Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG).**
 
• The **CAG is responsible for auditing the accounts** and activities of the three levels of government.
 
• **The President of India appoints the CAG **after receiving a recommendation from the Prime Minister.
 
• The CAG can only be removed from office if both houses of parliament pass an address against them for proven misbehaviour or incapacity
 
• **The CAG's term is six years or until they turn 65 years old, **whichever comes first. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Pratibha Parkar**

 
 
• She is Indian Ambassador to Cambodia (as of recent reports).
 
• Pratibha Parkar is a senior Indian Foreign Service (IFS) officer.
 
• She has served in various capacities in Indian missions abroad, representing India's interests in different countries.
 
 
 
• **Gaurav Ahluwalia**
 
 
• He is Indian High Commissioner to Mozambique (as of recent reports).
 
• Gaurav Ahluwalia is also an Indian Foreign Service (IFS) officer. Previously,
 
 
• he has served in important diplomatic positions, including being the Indian Consul General in Hong Kong.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Dinesh Bhatia**
 
 
• **​** Indian Ambassador to Argentina (as of recent reports).
 
• Dinesh Bhatia is an experienced diplomat in the Indian Foreign Service.
 
• He has served in several key roles, including being the Consul General of India in Toronto, Canada, before being appointed Ambassador to Argentina.
